card.name: Mixed positions inside words and numbers
card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires on scattered spots such as a letter inside a split word, a digit or decimal point inside a number, or a verb after a subject.

modes.label: Inside numbers
modes.description: A digit or decimal point partway through a figure, often a percentage or area.

modes.label: Partway through split words
modes.description: A first letter or stem of a word that continues in the next piece.
